name: Hist living
why: the game's start and every ending but Take and Give: the young Hist living (sick under MN03's sealed scar), its amber sap pool with the wardens' clutch, the five wardens at the camp; Huluxinoag's own living/dead parent (HuluxinoagCured) starts enabled

name: Hist dead (ending)
why: MN19's Take and Give part the trees (thing.mn19.dead-hists, under flag.mn.trees-parted): the parent disabled shows the young tree's dead twin in its place, the clutch gone with the tree, the sap pool cold and dark (its amber bowl off), the living tree's lantern gone; the village's people switched off (the camp empty)
